record.question: How many seats did the MNF win in the 2018 MLA Election in Mizoram?
record.explanation: Answer A: 26. The MNF won 26 of the 40 seats in the 2018 Mizoram Legislative Assembly election. Reference: https://www.eci.gov.in/files/file/9162-mizoram-assembly-elections-2018/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
